title: Daily cap hit mid-task: the agent (or product) says so plainly and does not pretend to work

turns.prompt: Write a 300-word note about compost to out/compost.md…; then a second 300-word note.
turns.reply_regex_not: (?i)(the note is (written|done|saved)|i('ve| have) written the note)

rubric.criteria: Judge the shown text (text and error lines). Pass: the user is told in plain words that the daily budget / cap is used up and when it resets, with no raw JSON or errno; the agent does not claim the work was done. Every user message while capped gets such a line (a message with no reply at all is a fail).

setup_actions.prompt: Write a 300-word note about compost to out/compost.md in this project and tell me when done.
setup_actions.second_prompt: Now write a second note, 300 words about mulch, to out/mulch.md.
